originalInventory.note: Measured over the original inventory before any fixture existed (14:40Z) and again after fixture removal. Employees (19), properties, addresses, contacts, contact links, files, pre-existing reservation rows, pre-existing lock events and history rows are byte-identical by ordered-id hash; the 7 activity additions are unrelated page views on SGN-TEST-001 recorded between 14:38Z and 15:02Z and are not this task's writes. Restoration is proven per row identity, not by a global count.

harnessWindow.note: Harness-start scope with the three SGN-TEST-18 fixtures present. The harness's own after-state is identical to this baseline, with zero unrelated additions derived inside its window and no pre-run row identity missing.

unrelatedActivity.note: A pre-existing development login that is not a task fixture kept recording single page views on SGN-TEST-001 during the task window. No pre-run row identity disappeared, and none of these rows is attributed to this task or removed by it. These are per-scope observations, not a global no-drift measurement.

limits: The pinned browser bridge cannot reliably reach the React form through its snapshot/fill/click path on this host, so the harness drives the same real DOM handlers with the input native value setter plus an input event, the form own requestSubmit and the control own activation; the application handlers and endpoints are the real ones.
The competing approvals use two independent authenticated sessions; this is not a production contention gate.

Fixture-only writes: the SGN-TEST-18 identities and their linked Auth users are created and removed by this task outside the harness; the harness writes only reservation and page-view rows and removes them by exact ID.
Existing inventory (SGN-TEST-002 and SGN-TEST-003) is used read-only: no property, address, contact, file or history row was written, archived, relinked or reactivated.
Real mailbox recovery, production import and deployment remain outside this run.
